column1: # Hand-written translation facts, merged over the generated rows of shader_facts.tsv by dm/gfx/tools/shader_split.py: key <TAB> facts JSON (same format)
# This game has no PC version, so the translator has no fragment output types and declares every output float; Metal refuses a pipeline whose float output meets an integer attachment.
# Its deferred model shaders (characters, Pokémon, field objects, effects) write colour 1 into an RGBA16Uint G-buffer target: every component of that output is a float -> uint conversion
# (F2I) bit-cast into the output register. The 260 rows below are every translated pixel shader whose colour output is written only that way (dm/gfx/tools/fout_scan.py over the
# Mac shader cache; it covers all 32 the host's red line named in a test run).
